transport.explanation: The eleven content-hashed model gzip payloads differ only at header offset 9 (local 0x0A, canonical remote 0x03). Decoded data is identical. Those hash changes propagate into referenced JS filenames; the HTML additionally orders the same preload resource set differently. Two canonical JS modules are identical after reference-hash tokens alone are normalized. The static geometry gzip itself is directly byte-identical.

limits: Normal uncleared browser cache; no controlled cold-network, mobile-device or all-device performance guarantee.
Previous Stage05 local playback predates these recordings and is a separate historical archive, not substituted for this remote verification.
A branch of the split shoal is partly occluded by the foreground reef. Existing model realism, scan edges and loading limits remain.
This is a finite neighbour-coordination demonstration with an authored route and one local stimulus, not real autonomous predation or a full food web.
The coordinated school holds its final pose after 240 seconds; this publication does not extend the finite simulation.
Narration playing events confirm media playback state and clip selection, not an independent human acoustic-quality review.
Repeated playing status events for the same media clip are preserved with per-clip counts; these events alone do not prove or exclude audible replay.

The first local-filename transport comparison retained three mismatches; canonical remote modules and decoded model data were verified separately. No equality to a downloaded workflow artifact is claimed because that download failed with unexpected EOF.
This finite publication is closed; no automatic further optimization or new assets are authorized by the archive.
